login.title: Login
login.subtitle: Enter your credentials to access your account
login.googleError: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.
login.genericError: Could not sign in. Please try again.
login.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes or sign in with Google or Telegram.
login.chooseClubSubtitle: Your account works in several clubs
login.noClubs: This account has no club yet — create the first one.
login.noAccessToClub: You have no access to the club “{club}”

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email you sign in with. We will send a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account with this email exists, we have sent a link. It is valid for 1 hour — check your inbox and spam folder.

resetPassword.title: New password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account
resetPassword.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit
resetPassword.success: Password changed. All other sessions have been signed out.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

errors.passwordRule: Needs an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit

resetPassword.setupSubtitle: This address has an account without a password — set one to sign in

confirmEmail.title: Email confirmation
confirmEmail.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has already been used. If your email is already confirmed, just sign in.
confirmEmail.resendNeedsLogin: Sign in to send the letter again.
confirmEmail.bannerText: We sent a letter with a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to confirm the address.

portalRegister.title: Club sign-up
portalRegister.subtitle: Your club and owner account — CRM access opens right away
portalRegister.slugHelp: It will appear in the CRM address: {url}
portalRegister.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit
portalRegister.acceptTerms: I accept the <terms>Terms and conditions</terms> and the <dpa>Data processing agreement</dpa>, and I have read the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>

errors.slugChars: Latin letters, digits and hyphens only
errors.passwordRule: Needs an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit
errors.acceptTerms: Accept the terms to create the club
errors.emailTaken: This email already has an account — sign in and create the club from the CRM.

newClub.title: New club
newClub.subtitle: The club will be yours: the owner is {email}.

join.title: Join {club}
join.subtitle: Fill in the club's form. If the club has already created an account for this email, the password activates it.
join.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit
join.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired.

errors.password: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit

done.title: Done!
done.checkEmail: You are in {club}. We have sent you an email with a confirmation link — open it to activate the account.
done.existing: You are in {club}. Sign in with your usual password.

signedIn.title: Join {club}
signedIn.subtitle: You are signed in as {email}. Fill in the club form to join with this account.
signedIn.noDocuments: This account has no documents yet. You can add them later in My passport.
signedIn.hint: Nothing selected means the club sees no documents. You can allow or withdraw access at any time.

kiosk.subtitle: Fill in the club form. If you already have an account, join from your own phone with the club link.
kiosk.existingAccount: This email already has an account. It is not signed into on a shared tablet — join from your own phone with the club link or QR.

consent.title: Join {club}?
consent.intro: {club} added {email} to its member list. The club will see only what you choose below, and only after you confirm with your account password.
consent.noDocuments: Your account has no documents yet. You can upload them later in your cabinet.
consent.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask the club to send it again.

done.confirmed: You are now a member of {club}. The club sees only the documents you selected.
done.declined: {club} will not see your data: the membership has been removed.

invite.title: Invitation to {club}
invite.subtitle: {email} · {role}
invite.invalid: The invitation is invalid or has expired.
invite.signedInAs: You are signed in as {email} — the invitation is for this address.
invite.otherSession: You are signed in as {email}, but the invitation is for another address. Accept it below.
invite.existingHint: This address already has an account — enter its password or continue with Google.
invite.passwordlessHint: The account has no password. Continue with Google or get an email to set one, then open the invitation again.
invite.sendSetupLink: Email me a link to set a password

errors.invite_email_mismatch: The Google address does not match the invitation. Sign in with the account the invitation was sent to.
errors.invite_invalid: The invitation is invalid or has expired.
errors.invite_already_employee: This account is already an employee of the club.

accepted_pending_email.title: Confirm your email
accepted_pending_email.text: We sent an email to {email}. Follow the link in it, then sign in to {club}.

confirm_email_first.title: Confirm your email first
confirm_email_first.text: {email} is not confirmed yet — we sent the email again. Confirm the address and open the invitation again.

password_setup_sent.title: Set a password
password_setup_sent.text: We sent a link to set a password to {email}. Then open the invitation again or accept it with Google.

invite.unconfirmedSession: You are signed in as {email}, but the email is not confirmed yet. Confirm it from the email or accept with Google.
